claim_text: PfpA is the hybrid PKS-NRPS assembly line that initiates phenylfuropyridone scaffold biosynthesis.
PfpB catalyzes the characteristic P450-dependent ring-expansion step downstream of PfpA.
PfpC is an SDR whose reconstruction-supported reduction step precedes dehydration to reactive ortho-quinone-methide intermediates.
Reactive ortho-quinone-methide chemistry generates multiple citridone-family scaffolds through competing electrocyclization, cycloisomerization and conjugate-addition routes.
The quaternary carbon center of citridone B is produced through an epoxide-forming P450 reaction followed by skeletal rearrangement.
The pfp cluster is sufficient in a heterologous A. nidulans host to access multiple members of the citridone phenylfuropyridone family.
Overexpression of the mca17 pathway regulator activates MCA17-1 production in an aurovertin-null C. arbuscula background.
supporting_detail_raw: Silent cluster was activated and MCA17-1 identified.
caveat_raw: The engineered background is part of the causal context.

claim_text: MCA17-1 is proposed to derive from the cluster's hybrid PKS-NRPS core enzyme.
supporting_detail_raw: Primary study proposes the biosynthetic origin.
caveat_raw: No complete heterologous enzyme-by-enzyme reconstruction.

claim_text: SwnK is required for swainsonine production and generates multiple pathway intermediates with domain skipping.
supporting_detail_raw: Loss abolishes detectable SW; mechanistic expression resolves intermediates.
caveat_raw: Canonical interval includes more genes than the conserved seven-gene SWN functional set.

claim_text: Pipecolic acid precursor supply is branched between SWN genes and unclustered fungal metabolism.
supporting_detail_raw: swnA/swnR loss reduces rather than abolishes production.
caveat_raw: Exact quantitative contributions vary with state.

claim_text: Swainsonine was dispensable for the tested plant-colonization and insect-infection phenotypes.
supporting_detail_raw: SW-deficient strains retained tested interaction phenotypes.
caveat_raw: Does not establish absence of all ecological functions.

claim_text: Deletion of atqA/ATEG_00700 links the NRPS-like gene directly to asterriquinone CT5 production in A. terreus NIH2624.
supporting_detail_raw: Metabolite profile lost in the atqA deletion strain.
caveat_raw: Does not assign specific steps to all neighboring canonical genes.

claim_text: Deletion of anaPS/ATEG_10305 links the two-module NRPS directly to the asterrelenin/epi-aszonalenin A metabolite family.
supporting_detail_raw: Associated indole-alkaloid peaks are lost in the deletion strain.
caveat_raw: Neighboring-gene functions are not equivalently validated.

claim_text: MIBiG substrate annotation supports tryptophan and anthranilate loading by anaPS.
supporting_detail_raw: Two modules are annotated with Trp and anthranilate substrate predictions.
caveat_raw: Substrate prediction is not a direct purified-enzyme assay.

claim_text: Deletion of btyA/ATEG_02815 directly links this NRPS-like enzyme to butyrolactone I/III production in A. terreus NIH2624.
supporting_detail_raw: Butyrolactone-related metabolite profile is lost in the btyA mutant.
caveat_raw: Does not validate every gene in the 19-gene canonical interval.

claim_text: BtyA is consistent with an aromatic α-keto-acid synthetase using 4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate.
supporting_detail_raw: MIBiG annotates 4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate and curated functional homology identifies BtyA.
caveat_raw: The 2013 deletion study is not a purified-enzyme reconstruction.

claim_text: Deletion of apvA/ATEG_02004 directly links the NRPS-like gene to aspulvinone H/B1 production in A. terreus NIH2624.
supporting_detail_raw: Aspulvinone-related metabolite profile is lost in the deletion strain.
caveat_raw: Does not by itself establish the detailed catalytic mechanism.

claim_text: ApvA is predicted to use 4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate as its aromatic α-keto-acid substrate.
supporting_detail_raw: MIBiG module annotation gives 4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate.
caveat_raw: No direct purified-enzyme substrate assay in the defining deletion study.

claim_text: AnATPKS is an NRPS–NRPKS hybrid megasynthetase sufficient to build amino-acid-derived α-pyrone pathway products in a heterologous fungal host.
supporting_detail_raw: Heterologous expression produces pyrophen-pathway metabolites.
caveat_raw: Native regulation is not inferred from heterologous sufficiency.

claim_text: AnOMT directly methylates pyrophen-pathway intermediates.
supporting_detail_raw: SAM-dependent conversion observed with active but not boiled enzyme.
caveat_raw: Specific in-vivo flux contribution depends on expression context.

claim_text: The AnATPKS adenylation domain is promiscuous toward substituted phenylalanines, enabling precursor-directed analogue biosynthesis.
supporting_detail_raw: Multiple substituted analogues were accessed and characterized.
caveat_raw: Engineered analogue generation is not evidence that all analogues are native metabolites.

claim_text: ATRR catalyzes two sequential two-electron reductions converting glycine betaine to choline through glycine betaine aldehyde.
supporting_detail_raw: Biochemical function established with substrate/inhibitor analysis.
caveat_raw: This is primary-metabolic/homeostatic chemistry despite NRPS-like architecture.

claim_text: ATRR is required for normal choline biosynthesis and glycine-betaine homeostasis in A. nidulans.
supporting_detail_raw: Δatrr growth/metabolic phenotype is rescued by choline under betaine challenge.
caveat_raw: Assay-specific physiological role; broader fungal regulation remains open.

claim_text: GreA directly activates aromatic α-keto acids and catalyzes atromentin formation.
supporting_detail_raw: Biochemical characterization establishes substrate activation and product formation.
caveat_raw: Native regulatory context is outside the enzyme-assay evidence.

claim_text: The GreA adenylation domain recognizes aromatic α-keto acids including 4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate and phenylpyruvate.
supporting_detail_raw: Direct substrate-specificity measurements underpin the nonribosomal code proposal.
caveat_raw: Assay substrate range is not identical to native flux distribution.

claim_text: Deletion of PbhdaA derepresses the brs programme, elevates brs transcription and reveals brasiliamide I production.
supporting_detail_raw: Wild type and ΔPbhdaA were directly compared.
caveat_raw: Does not imply PbhdaA is a pathway enzyme.

claim_text: BrsA stereoselectively accepts L-phenylalanine and is required for formation of the brasiliamide piperazine scaffold.
evidence_type_raw: gene deletion + purified full-length NRPS assay
supporting_detail_raw: Core genetics and in-vitro substrate selectivity agree.
caveat_raw: Detailed downstream tailoring is separate from this core assignment.

claim_text: BrsJ is an α-ketoglutarate-dependent nonheme iron dioxygenase that cleaves the piperazine ring during brasiliamide A biosynthesis.
supporting_detail_raw: Direct late tailoring chemistry.
caveat_raw: Applies to the demonstrated substrate/pathway context.

claim_text: BrsH and BrsD participate in brasiliamide tailoring, but their exact chemical steps are less completely resolved in the available evidence.
supporting_detail_raw: Deletion changes pathway output.
caveat_raw: Do not assign a specific enzyme reaction without stronger direct evidence.

claim_text: The defining study directly established two O. olearius sesquiterpene synthases that produce δ-6 protoilludene as their dominant product.
supporting_detail_raw: Omp6 ~95%; Omp7 ~96% δ-6 protoilludene.
caveat_raw: Exact mapping of Omp6 versus Omp7 to BGC0002279 is unresolved.

claim_text: Native sesquiterpene-synthase neighborhoods show coordinated transcription during growth.
supporting_detail_raw: STS and neighboring putative biosynthetic genes were coregulated.
caveat_raw: Coexpression alone does not prove each neighboring enzyme step.

claim_text: BGC0002279 is retained as a retired canonical protoilludene interval without forcing an unsupported Omp6/Omp7 historical label.
supporting_detail_raw: Canonical interval and defining locus-pair biology agree at product-family level.
caveat_raw: Accession-level label mapping remains open.

claim_text: The defining study directly established two O. olearius sesquiterpene synthases that produce δ-6 protoilludene as their dominant product.
supporting_detail_raw: Omp6 ~95%; Omp7 ~96% δ-6 protoilludene.
caveat_raw: Exact mapping of Omp6 versus Omp7 to BGC0002280 is unresolved.

claim_text: Native sesquiterpene-synthase neighborhoods show coordinated transcription during growth.
supporting_detail_raw: STS and neighboring putative biosynthetic genes were coregulated.
caveat_raw: Coexpression alone does not prove each neighboring enzyme step.

claim_text: BGC0002280 is retained as a retired canonical protoilludene interval without forcing an unsupported Omp6/Omp7 historical label.
supporting_detail_raw: Canonical interval and defining locus-pair biology agree at product-family level.
caveat_raw: Accession-level label mapping remains open.

claim_text: F. commune smb genes are sufficient to reconstruct (-)-sambutoxin biosynthesis stepwise in Aspergillus nidulans.
supporting_detail_raw: Genomic DNA from F. commune supplied the pathway genes.
caveat_raw: This is heterologous sufficiency, not a native F. commune knockout.

claim_text: SmbE installs C11 hydroxylation that enables tetrahydropyran formation through intramolecular Michael addition.
supporting_detail_raw: Tetrahydropyran-bearing intermediate 13 characterized.
caveat_raw: Ring closure follows the oxidation and is not assigned as a separate enzyme reaction.

claim_text: SmbF installs the para-hydroxyl group late on a phenylalanine-derived side chain rather than by direct tyrosine incorporation.
supporting_detail_raw: N-demethylsambutoxin appears after SmbF.
caveat_raw: Corrects the intuitive precursor model.

claim_text: SmbG catalyzes the final N-methylation to sambutoxin.
supporting_detail_raw: KM and kcat measured for N-demethylsambutoxin.
caveat_raw: Native regulation is outside this assay.

claim_text: The bis gene programme is sufficient in heterologous systems to reconstruct biscognienyne/eutypinic-acid pathway chemistry.
supporting_detail_raw: Multiple pathway products/intermediates were recovered.
caveat_raw: Native regulation is not inferred from heterologous sufficiency.

claim_text: BisI is a cytochrome P450 alkynylase that directly constructs an alkyne on prenyl chains.
supporting_detail_raw: Defining study established unprecedented P450 alkynylation.
caveat_raw: Applies to tested prenyl substrates.

claim_text: BisI accepts both C5 and C15 prenyl-chain substrates.
supporting_detail_raw: Demonstrates substrate promiscuity.
caveat_raw: Engineered substrate range does not define native flux.

claim_text: The broad MIBiG product list contains pathway intermediates and branch products as well as principal natural products.
supporting_detail_raw: Twelve listed outputs are not interpreted as twelve equivalent final products.
caveat_raw: Preserves product semantics.

claim_text: AshL-class fungal laccase catalysis can impose regio- and atropselective oxidative phenol coupling on γ-naphthopyrones.
supporting_detail_raw: Enantioenriched dimeric naphthopyrones formed.
caveat_raw: Condition-dependent flexibility observed for one compared enzyme should not be generalized to every laccase.

claim_text: The Aschersonia locus links the nrPKS AshP to naphthopyrone monomer formation and AshL to dimerization toward (P)-ustilaginoidin A.
supporting_detail_raw: Core PKS–laccase pathway logic.
caveat_raw: Two other canonical genes remain less resolved.

claim_text: Axial chirality can be controlled directly by fungal laccase catalysis rather than arising solely from nonselective oxidation.
supporting_detail_raw: Three enzymes were highly P-selective.
caveat_raw: Specific selectivity remains enzyme/condition dependent.

claim_text: PvhE suppresses premature nonenzymatic trans-decalin formation by oxidizing a terminal methyl group to a carboxylate.
supporting_detail_raw: Reactive 3 is converted to less-reactive 6.
caveat_raw: Deactivation is chemical control preceding final DAase catalysis.

claim_text: PvhB catalyzes the final exo-selective IMDA reaction that forms the cis-octahydrodecalin core.
supporting_detail_raw: >95% conversion and kinetic constants measured.
caveat_raw: Applies to carboxylated substrates 6/7.

claim_text: PvhD methylation biases the pathway toward varicidin A and strongly improves PvhB turnover of substrate 7.
supporting_detail_raw: pvhD omission produces B; PvhB kcat is much higher for 7.
caveat_raw: Methylation is not itself the cyclization step.

claim_text: Varicidin A and B show antifungal activity against Candida albicans at 8 and 16 µg/mL MIC, respectively.
supporting_detail_raw: A is more potent under the reported assay.
caveat_raw: Does not establish native ecological function.

claim_text: Pc20g10860 is a bifunctional diterpene synthase that constructs deoxyconidiogenol through a cyclization involving successive 1,2-alkyl shifts.
supporting_detail_raw: Cyclization mechanism experimentally traced.
caveat_raw: Mechanistic proof is enzyme-level, not native regulation.

claim_text: Pc20g10870 catalyzes two oxidation rounds from deoxyconidiogenol to conidiogenone.
supporting_detail_raw: Two-gene pathway yields final product.
caveat_raw: No additional enzyme required for the demonstrated conversion.

claim_text: Conidiogenone is historically a conidiation-inducing factor in P. cyclopium, but the defining P. rubens pathway study does not directly demonstrate that signaling phenotype in Wisconsin 54-1255.
supporting_detail_raw: Similar biosynthetic genes occur across many Penicillium species.
caveat_raw: Do not transfer developmental phenotype as strain-specific proof.

claim_text: Snf2 is required for normal access to the M. pulcherrima pulcherriminic-acid programme.
supporting_detail_raw: snf2 premature-stop mutant loses pigmentation and strongly represses PUL1-3; wild-type SNF2 complementation restores pigmentation/antagonism.
caveat_raw: Snf2 is a global chromatin remodeler, not a pathway-specific enzyme.

claim_text: Cyclo(Leu-Leu), pulcherriminic acid and related pulcherrimin-associated metabolites depend strongly on Snf2 state under the tested conditions.
supporting_detail_raw: Metabolites are detected in WT/complemented strains and undetectable in pigmentless snf2 mutant.
caveat_raw: Does not by itself assign each metabolite to a specific PUL enzyme.

claim_text: PUL1, PUL2 and PUL3 are among the most strongly downregulated transcripts in the snf2 mutant, with PUL2 reduced about 2000-fold.
supporting_detail_raw: PUL1 and PUL3 >100-fold lower; PUL2 ~2000-fold lower; PUL4 lowly expressed and less affected.
caveat_raw: Broad genome-wide transcriptional changes accompany the PUL effect.

claim_text: Reduced antifungal activity in the snf2 mutant is associated with loss of pulcherrimin-pathway metabolites but cannot be attributed uniquely to pulcherrimin.
supporting_detail_raw: SNF2 complementation restores strong antagonism and pigmentation.
caveat_raw: Snf2 also alters candidapepsins, transporters and many other genes.

claim_text: MelA directly converts 4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate into aspulvinone E.
supporting_detail_raw: MelA/ATEG_03563 is conidiation-induced and biochemically assigned.
caveat_raw: MIBiG classifies the locus as NRPS although MelA is an unusual NRPS-like synthetase rather than a canonical peptide assembly line.

claim_text: TyrP oxidatively activates aspulvinone E and the reactive products spontaneously polymerize into Asp-melanin.
supporting_detail_raw: Core two-enzyme pigment pathway is reconstructed.
caveat_raw: Polymerization itself is spontaneous after TyrP chemistry.

claim_text: Asp-melanin protects A. terreus conidia from UV stress and reduces phagocytosis by soil amoeba.
supporting_detail_raw: Pigment-deficient mutants lose protective phenotypes.
caveat_raw: Does not imply all ecological or host-survival effects are mediated solely through this pathway.

claim_text: Asp-melanin does not block acidification of phagolysosomes, distinguishing it functionally from some canonical Aspergillus melanins.
supporting_detail_raw: Acidification remains detectable despite pigment.
caveat_raw: Functional difference should not be generalized beyond tested conditions.

claim_text: The 2023 RSC aspulvinone synthesis paper listed by the canonical source is chemically relevant but is not defining evidence for BGC identity or MelA/TyrP function.
supporting_detail_raw: 2016 Cell Chemical Biology paper supplies the causal biosynthesis/functional evidence.
caveat_raw: Retain the 2023 paper only as product-chemistry context.

claim_text: The ctd cluster is causally responsible for 21R-citrinadin A biosynthesis in P. citrinum ATCC 9849.
supporting_detail_raw: ΔctdQ completely abolishes product 1.
caveat_raw: Does not by itself assign every tailoring gene.

claim_text: CtdE stereoselectively constructs the 3S-spirooxindole by FAD-dependent epoxidation/semipinacol rearrangement.
evidence_type_raw: native knockout + purified enzyme + crystallography + mutagenesis/computation
supporting_detail_raw: Defined substrates/products and high-resolution complexes support β-face epoxidation.
caveat_raw: Mechanistic epoxide is inferred from integrated structural/computational evidence rather than directly isolated.

claim_text: CtdU is required for normal C7 prenylation in the citrinadin pathway.
supporting_detail_raw: ΔctdU accumulates non-C7-prenylated pathway intermediates.
caveat_raw: Purified CtdU assay was not the defining evidence reported here.

claim_text: Aetokthonotoxin is not a supported product of fungal BGC0002368.
supporting_detail_raw: Current MIBiG assigns aetokthonotoxin to Aetokthonos hydrillicola BGC0002643.
caveat_raw: Canonical source row is retained as provenance but its contaminated product field is not propagated.

claim_text: SW67 produces cladosporiumins I and J and their absolute structures are experimentally resolved.
supporting_detail_raw: NMR, Mosher, ECD and computational NMR used.
caveat_raw: Does not itself identify the causal BGC.

claim_text: The cls PKS-NRPS locus is a plausible genetic basis for SW67 tetramic-acid metabolites.
supporting_detail_raw: ClsI/ClsK are the strongest candidate genes.
caveat_raw: No knockout, heterologous reconstruction or purified-enzyme validation.

claim_text: Cladosporiumins/cladosporicin show only weak cytotoxicity in the reported breast-cancer panel.
supporting_detail_raw: IC50 approximately 70–90 µM.
caveat_raw: Does not establish ecological function.

claim_text: A conserved fungal DDP core comprising NR-PKS, C20-prenyl supply/transfer and oxidative/cyclization enzymes is sufficient to generate the shared decalin-containing diterpenoid-pyrone intermediate.
supporting_detail_raw: Common intermediate 4 produced at 87 mg/L.
caveat_raw: Uses heterologous host and cross-species orthologues.

claim_text: The Metarhizium BBE-domain SubF/DpmaF branch enzyme converts the common DDP pathway toward subglutinols A and B.
supporting_detail_raw: Subglutinol A 89 mg/L; B 6 mg/L after branch-enzyme addition.
caveat_raw: Native ARSEF 23 knockout evidence NR.

claim_text: Subglutinol A has potent Drosophila-cell cytotoxicity and produces acute paralysis after adult-fly injection.
supporting_detail_raw: DL-1 IC50 12 nM; 3.5 ng/fly acute assay.
caveat_raw: These assays do not establish native fungal virulence causality.

claim_text: The 2020 reconstruction supports Metarhizium pathway-family chemistry but should not be described as a native M. robertsii ARSEF 23 expression or knockout experiment.
supporting_detail_raw: M. anisopliae NBRC103233 supplied genes for the reconstructed dpma pathway.
caveat_raw: Conservation supports orthology, not strain-specific direct evidence.

claim_text: The dpfgA-E/G-K programme is sufficient to reconstruct the F. graminearum decalin-containing diterpenoid-pyrone pathway and its FDDP-D/E endpoints.
supporting_detail_raw: Full late branch yields FDDP-D/E and resolves pathway order.
caveat_raw: 2020 donor strain was 50218 rather than PH-1.

claim_text: Native CRISPR disruption of the C16 PKS and terpene synthase independently confirms FDDP-D and FDDP-E as F. graminearum cluster products.
supporting_detail_raw: UHPLC-HRMS and targeted MS2 distinguish transformants from controls.
caveat_raw: Does not by itself prove each tailoring gene.

claim_text: FDDP-D and FDDP-E are produced during experimental wheat-head infection.
supporting_detail_raw: Both products detected in challenged wheat heads.
caveat_raw: In-planta detection is not equivalent to a virulence phenotype.

claim_text: The retired MIBiG coordinate fragment cannot represent the experimentally defined ten-gene C16 pathway and should not be used as the functional programme boundary.
supporting_detail_raw: Source interval is 1,537 bp whereas ten biosynthetic genes are experimentally implicated.
caveat_raw: Retain coordinates only for ledger provenance.

claim_text: The conserved dpch DDP pathway is sufficient in heterologous reconstruction to generate higginsianin-family chemistry, with DpchG/H mediating C8 inversion and DpchF completing higginsianin A formation.
supporting_detail_raw: Higginsianin A produced at 28 mg/L after dpchGHF addition.
caveat_raw: 2020 donor was MAFF305635 rather than canonical IMI 349063.

claim_text: Loss of CclA/COMPASS function increases accessible secondary-metabolite diversity and reveals higginsianin C and 13-epi-higginsianin C in native C. higginsianum culture.
supporting_detail_raw: ΔcclA liquid fermentation yielded new higginsianin congeners.
caveat_raw: CclA is global, so pathway-specific regulatory mechanism is not inferred.

claim_text: Higginsianin B directly suppresses jasmonate-mediated plant defence signalling by preventing JAZ-protein degradation and inhibiting proteasome-dependent target turnover.
supporting_detail_raw: Jas9-VENUS, reporter and protease assays converge.
caveat_raw: Purified-compound activity does not establish endogenous infection dose or virulence necessity.

claim_text: Higginsianin E exhibits selective antiproliferative activity in the reported A431 assay, with IC50 1.0 µM and low effect on immortalized keratinocytes.
supporting_detail_raw: Congener-specific pharmacology is separate from native ecological role.

claim_text: Sporidesmin A is an established spore-associated ETP mycotoxin of Pseudopithomyces/Pithomyces chartarum that causes facial eczema in grazing ruminants.
supporting_detail_raw: Toxin identity and disease link are well established.
caveat_raw: This claim is independent of exact BGC identity.

claim_text: The Spd locus is a biologically plausible sporidesmin biosynthetic candidate because it contains an ETP-like complement of genes homologous to aspirochlorine, sirodesmin and gliotoxin clusters.
supporting_detail_raw: Defining study identified a single locus with the predicted functional repertoire.
caveat_raw: No pathway-specific causal experiment was reported.

claim_text: Current evidence does not justify treating individual Spd gene annotations as experimentally demonstrated sporidesmin enzyme functions.
supporting_detail_raw: Gene functions are annotation/homology assignments.
caveat_raw: Future knockouts/reconstitution could upgrade them.

claim_text: The MIBiG record should be used as a candidate-BGC record rather than as equivalent in causal depth to experimentally reconstructed fungal pathways.
supporting_detail_raw: Primary source repeatedly describes the cluster as putative.
caveat_raw: Active database status does not supersede evidence type.

claim_text: Pro1 catalyzes the pathway-committing cyclization of FPP to 6-protoilludene for Armillaria protoilludene aryl esters.
supporting_detail_raw: Previously isolated Pro1 gene is physically embedded in the cluster.
caveat_raw: Does not by itself specify downstream aryl-ester product.

claim_text: CYP-Arm3 converts 6-protoilludene to 8α-hydroxy-6-protoilludene, establishing the first oxygenation step toward the Δ6–7 armillyl-orsellinate branch.
supporting_detail_raw: Product identity stereochemically resolved by NMR.
caveat_raw: Later pathway chemistry remains unresolved.

claim_text: CYP-Arm2 shows weak activity on 6-protoilludene, whereas CYP-Arm1 and CYP-Arm4 do not generate novel products from that tested substrate.
supporting_detail_raw: Negative and weak-positive results constrain substrate ordering.
caveat_raw: They may act on downstream substrates not tested.

claim_text: The five-gene MIBiG locus is an experimentally strong early module, not a complete reconstruction of armillyl orsellinate biosynthesis.
supporting_detail_raw: ArmB/halogenases and additional oxygenation steps are outside the fully resolved module.
caveat_raw: Database endpoint naming can otherwise overstate completeness.

claim_text: BsPS/Ssk6 is a bifunctional sesterterpene synthase that constructs the 5–15 trans-fused bicyclic preterpestacin-I scaffold.
supporting_detail_raw: BFTS sub-clade identified by genome mining and catalytic assays.
caveat_raw: Late tailoring chemistry is separate from scaffold synthesis.

claim_text: Native deletion of the BS11134 BFTS gene provides causal evidence that this locus produces the preterpestacin-derived sesterterpenoid family.
supporting_detail_raw: Deletion-guided isolation yielded new pathway congeners.
caveat_raw: Does not individually validate every neighboring tailoring enzyme.

claim_text: The BS11134 locus contains a distinctive glycosyltransferase-associated branch absent from many homologous 5–15 BFTS clusters.
supporting_detail_raw: Glycosylated sesterterpenoid recovered from native culture.
caveat_raw: Exact enzyme-substrate reaction was not purified here.

claim_text: Moderate NO-inhibition by selected downstream congeners should not be transferred to preterpestacin I or interpreted as the native ecological function of the BGC.
supporting_detail_raw: Compound 2 and sestersorokinicin A/compound 4 were active at 10 µM.
caveat_raw: Activity is assay-specific and congener-specific.

claim_text: Among 32 annotated C. uncialis PKSs, the defining study identified one nrPKS candidate whose CMeT/CLC architecture and adjacent oxidative gene fit the proposed usnic-acid biosynthetic model.
supporting_detail_raw: Candidate selection is unusually specific within the genome.
caveat_raw: Specificity of prediction is not biochemical proof.

claim_text: mpas and mpao are transcriptionally active in an intact lichen sample in which usnic acid is detected by HPLC.
supporting_detail_raw: Expression and product are observed in the same native lichen context.
caveat_raw: Co-occurrence does not establish necessity or sufficiency.

claim_text: MPAS and MPAO remain proposed pathway functions in C. uncialis because no pathway-specific knockout, complementation, heterologous product reconstruction or direct catalytic reconstitution was reported.
supporting_detail_raw: The primary paper itself calls the cluster putative.
caveat_raw: Later database/protein annotations should not be mistaken for new causal experiments.

claim_text: BGC0002483 should be retained as a candidate-locus record rather than treated as an experimentally reconstructed usnic-acid BGC.
supporting_detail_raw: Active MIBiG status coexists with candidate-level causal evidence.
caveat_raw: Useful for atlas evidence-tiering, not as a direct validation benchmark.

claim_text: P. steckii YE natively produces a chemically interconverting family of α,β-polysulfide ETPs including penigainamides and adametizine A.
evidence_type_raw: native fermentation + structural isolation + transformation assays
supporting_detail_raw: Three new and five known congeners characterized.
caveat_raw: Product-family evidence does not by itself validate the proposed gene-level pathway.

claim_text: Several observed ETP congeners can arise or disappear through nonenzymatic transformations after biosynthesis.
supporting_detail_raw: Transformations depend on solvent/time and sulfur/epoxide chemistry.
caveat_raw: Atlas must not assign every congener change to a tailoring enzyme.

claim_text: The 53-kb pen cluster is a strong candidate for the shared biosynthetic origin of these ETPs, based on NRPS/tailoring content and homology to established ETP clusters.
supporting_detail_raw: Full sulfur-incorporation machinery and multiple P450s are present.
caveat_raw: No pen-cluster knockout/reconstruction was performed in the defining study.

claim_text: The defining paper's proposed Pen enzyme sequence should not be represented as direct enzymatic validation despite the MIBiG evidence label.
supporting_detail_raw: Paper explicitly states future studies will test the proposed pathway.
caveat_raw: Direct mechanistic certainty belongs to compound interconversion, not gene assignments.

claim_text: Fumonisin production in the G9×G1 cross maps directly to the FUM-cluster haplotype.
supporting_detail_raw: 24/24 producers were G9 type and 18/18 nonproducers G1 type at FUM markers.
caveat_raw: Establishes cluster localization of natural nonproduction defect.

claim_text: G1 fumonisin nonproduction is polygenic within the FUM cluster, with causal defects distributed in FUM21 and the FUM7 region.
supporting_detail_raw: Single-region complements fail; combined FUM21+FUM7-region repair restores production.
caveat_raw: Additional weak lesions may remain because restoration can be below G9 levels.

claim_text: The FUM21 p.G678* C-terminal truncation is one causal regulatory lesion in G1.
supporting_detail_raw: FUM21 repair restores downstream FUM transcription; p.G678* mutant construct fails to restore production in fully integrated transformants.
caveat_raw: FUM21 repair alone is insufficient because FUM7-region defect also exists.

claim_text: Detailed catalytic functions of many FUM genes should be cited as homologous Fusarium pathway knowledge rather than strain-specific F. fujikuroi enzyme assays.
supporting_detail_raw: 2019 G9/G1 study directly tests linkage, expression and complementation.
caveat_raw: Prevents ortholog evidence transfer.

claim_text: XenE together with XenG forms the reduced tyrosine-nonaketide skeleton that seeds xenoacremone biosynthesis.
supporting_detail_raw: Core scaffold formation confirmed.
caveat_raw: Native regulation not inferred from heterologous sufficiency.

claim_text: XenF catalyzes a sigmatropic rearrangement that generates the key cyclohexane intermediate required for the fused ring system.
supporting_detail_raw: XenF step precedes XenD/XenC.
caveat_raw: Applies to tested pathway intermediates.

claim_text: XenD oxidation supplies the substrate for XenC-mediated para-cyclophane ether formation, after which Diels-Alder closure is spontaneous.
supporting_detail_raw: Three-enzyme late-stage cascade resolves enzyme-controlled versus spontaneous steps.
caveat_raw: Final pericyclic event is not assigned to a dedicated DAase.

claim_text: The MT876600 xen locus is experimentally tied to X. sinensis ML-31 in the defining study despite MIBiG's BF-2018a organism label.

supporting_detail_raw: The compact cluster conserves SdnA, four P450s, SdnG, glycosyltransferase and methyltransferase homologs.

claim_text: SdnG is a norbornene-forming Diels-Alderase that accelerates the intramolecular cycloaddition in sordaricin biosynthesis.
supporting_detail_raw: Full sordaricin reconstruction plus SdnG characterization establishes the enzyme mechanism.
caveat_raw: This direct proof belongs to S. araneosa SdnG, not the R. necatrix homolog.

claim_text: The complete S. araneosa sordaricin pathway yields 20 mg/L in A. nidulans and 2 mg/L in S. cerevisiae.
supporting_detail_raw: All core transformations to sordaricin were experimentally reconstructed.
caveat_raw: Useful homologous mechanism, not direct R. necatrix product formation.

claim_text: Halovirs I–K are native metabolites of P. roridum NRRL 2183 and were isolated from solid culture.
evidence_type_raw: native metabolite isolation and structure elucidation
supporting_detail_raw: Three new hexapeptide lipopeptaibols were isolated and characterized by NMR/MS/MS and stereochemical analysis.
caveat_raw: This proves metabolite production, not BGC causality.

claim_text: The PrHalA-containing locus is a candidate halovir biosynthetic gene cluster.
evidence_type_raw: genome mining and NRPS module/domain analysis
supporting_detail_raw: The defining paper states that genome bioinformatics revealed a cluster likely responsible for halovir I–K and proposes nonlinear PrHalA assembly.
caveat_raw: No knockout, complementation, direct enzyme assay or heterologous reconstruction is reported.

claim_text: Halovirs I and J have potent antibacterial activity against sensitive and multidrug-resistant Gram-positive pathogens, and the lipopeptaibols show micromolar cytotoxicity.
supporting_detail_raw: Cytotoxic IC50 values are reported in the 1.3–3.3 μM range for A549, MCF-7 and HeLa cells.
caveat_raw: Exact compound-by-organism antibacterial values are not available in the accessible abstract.

claim_text: SdxC, SdxD and SdxA are sufficient together in A. nidulans to generate the dephenylated 2-pyridone ketone precursor 12.
supporting_detail_raw: Three-gene expression yielded structurally confirmed ketone 12 at 2 mg/L.
caveat_raw: The experiment establishes the combined module rather than isolated single-gene necessity.

claim_text: Reduction of ketone 12 initiates chemistry that yields M- and P-deoxyakanthomycin through a substrate-controlled late cyclization.
evidence_type_raw: SDR assays + chemical reduction control + computation
supporting_detail_raw: SDR homologs plus NADPH and independent NaBH4 reduction both produce the atropisomers.
caveat_raw: No dedicated enzyme should be assigned as the seven-membered-ring cyclase.

claim_text: Direct catalytic evidence for SdxG itself is weaker than for the SDR reaction class because the reported soluble assays used homologs PdxG, AdxG and EpiG.
supporting_detail_raw: The homolog assays establish reaction feasibility and pathway logic.
caveat_raw: Do not transfer homolog enzymology to SdxG as strain-specific direct evidence.

claim_text: SdxB-mediated N-hydroxylation of deoxyakanthomycin to akanthomycin is proposed rather than directly demonstrated.
supporting_detail_raw: SdxB is annotated as a putative N-hydroxylation P450.
caveat_raw: No direct SdxB functional experiment reported.

claim_text: Xylaroamide A is directly produced by Xylaria sp. 218_066 and is a fully characterized cyclic heptadepsipeptide.
supporting_detail_raw: LC-MS-guided isolation and multiple orthogonal stereochemical methods define the molecule.
caveat_raw: Does not by itself establish the BGC.

claim_text: The candidate NRPS/trans-acting N-methyltransferase programme is a plausible biosynthetic model, not a causally validated BGC.
supporting_detail_raw: Defining paper explicitly describes the pathway as proposed based on bioinformatics.
caveat_raw: No direct knockout, complementation, reconstruction or enzyme assay.

claim_text: Xylaroamide A inhibits BT-549 and RKO cancer cell lines at low-micromolar concentrations.
supporting_detail_raw: Reported IC50 values are 2.5 and 9.5 μM, respectively.
caveat_raw: Cell-line activity should not be converted into a native ecological-role claim.

claim_text: FfnC directly reduces phosphonoacetaldehyde to 2-hydroxyethylphosphonic acid.
supporting_detail_raw: Defined substrate and cofactor assay establishes the early reduction step.
caveat_raw: This is an early pathway step, not complete fosfonochlorin synthesis.

claim_text: FfnD is an Fe(II)/2OG-dependent oxacyclase that converts 2-hydroxyethylphosphonic acid to (S)-epoxyethylphosphonic acid.
supporting_detail_raw: The enzyme suppresses normal oxygen rebound for the alcohol substrate and drives epoxide formation.
caveat_raw: Later conversion to the chloroacetyl final product remains unknown.

claim_text: The conserved FfnABCD neighborhoods in Fusarium and Talaromyces support a fosfonochlorin-family early biosynthetic module.
supporting_detail_raw: PepM-network analysis groups strains carrying the conserved module, and FfnC/FfnD activities fit the proposed route.
caveat_raw: Full locus necessity/sufficiency and final-product reconstruction were not demonstrated.

claim_text: Copu5 directly catalyzes formation of (+)-δ-cadinol from FPP.
supporting_detail_raw: (+)-δ-cadinol is the dominant product, accompanied by minor sesquiterpenes.
caveat_raw: Native C. puteana production was not demonstrated.

claim_text: Optimized E. coli expressing Copu5 produces (+)-δ-cadinol at 225 mg/L with 4.7 mg/L/h productivity.
supporting_detail_raw: Scale-up establishes biotechnological production capacity.
caveat_raw: This is engineered-host performance, not a native fungal titer.

claim_text: The surrounding BGC0002707 genes are not established as necessary components of δ-cadinol biosynthesis.
supporting_detail_raw: Direct functional work centers on Copu5.
caveat_raw: Do not infer transporter/reductase roles from genomic proximity alone.

claim_text: Copu9/CONPUDRAFT_118913 directly catalyzes formation of (+)-δ-cadinol from FPP.
evidence_type_raw: heterologous expression + product identification + structural identity
supporting_detail_raw: PDB 7OFL links CONPUDRAFT_118913 to Copu9, while heterologous expression establishes product chemistry.
caveat_raw: Native C. puteana production was not demonstrated.

claim_text: Optimized E. coli expressing Copu9 produces (+)-δ-cadinol at 395 mg/L with 8.2 mg/L/h productivity.
supporting_detail_raw: Copu9 outperforms the Copu5 production strain under the reported optimized conditions.
caveat_raw: This is engineered-host performance, not a native fungal titer.

claim_text: Copu9 structure and mutagenesis provide direct structural-mechanistic support for its sesquiterpene cyclase function.
supporting_detail_raw: PDB 7OFL was solved at 1.83 Å and structure-guided mutants were functionally profiled.
caveat_raw: Structural insight does not establish native pathway regulation.

claim_text: The aurofusarin cluster is causally established by native targeted gene replacements and complementation/overexpression.
supporting_detail_raw: Multiple cluster genes produce pathway-specific loss or intermediate-accumulation phenotypes.
caveat_raw: Exact late extracellular protein-complex chemistry remains partly model-based.

claim_text: PKS12 produces YWA1 as the primary polyketide product, and AurZ acts before AurJ.
supporting_detail_raw: ΔaurZ and ΔaurZ/ΔaurJ accumulate YWA1, correcting the older precursor model.
caveat_raw: This supersedes the earlier direct-PKS12-to-nor-rubrofusarin interpretation.

claim_text: AurT-dependent transport and late mutant phenotypes support rubrofusarin export before extracellular conversion to aurofusarin.
supporting_detail_raw: ΔaurT increases the rubrofusarin-to-aurofusarin ratio; AurS/Gip1/AurF/AurO mutants accumulate rubrofusarin.
caveat_raw: The precise extracellular complex and reaction sequence are proposed rather than fully biochemically reconstituted.

claim_text: Iron deficiency induces the metachelin/dimerumic-acid siderophore programme in M. robertsii.
supporting_detail_raw: mrsidA/mrsidD are strongly upregulated and differential siderophores accumulate under iron deficiency.
caveat_raw: Iron limitation is an experimentally resolved context cue, not merely inferred ecology.

claim_text: mrsidA and mrsidD are causally required for production of all six measured coprogen/dimerumic-acid siderophores.
supporting_detail_raw: Both deletion mutants lose compounds 1–6.
caveat_raw: The detailed enzymatic routes to each congener remain proposed.

claim_text: mrapdA is iron-responsive but is not required for the six-product siderophore profile measured in the study.
supporting_detail_raw: ΔmrapdA showed no significant secondary-metabolite change versus WT.
caveat_raw: Negative evidence should be retained rather than forcing the gene into the pathway.

claim_text: B. sorokiniana 11134 directly produces the chlorinated chromone/xanthone metabolite set represented in BGC0002726.
supporting_detail_raw: Multiple products were isolated and identified by NMR/HRESIMS.
caveat_raw: Direct production does not establish the proposed BGC causally.

claim_text: The BGC and detailed biosynthetic pathway are proposed from halogenase/genome mining and metabolite relationships.
supporting_detail_raw: Defining publication explicitly describes proposed BGCs/pathway.
caveat_raw: No knockout, complementation, reconstruction or direct enzyme assay reported.

claim_text: One newly discovered chlorinated metabolite has antibacterial activity against S. aureus and resistant strains at 12.5 μg/mL.
supporting_detail_raw: Shared MIC across S. aureus, MRSA and three resistant S. aureus clinical isolates.
caveat_raw: Do not generalize this MIC to every MIBiG-listed product.

claim_text: iliA+iliB+iliC+iliD are sufficient for heterologous production of ilicicolin H and J.
supporting_detail_raw: pDH5 produced both products in A. nidulans.
caveat_raw: Does not by itself isolate each enzyme's catalytic mechanism.

claim_text: IliE is not required for H/J formation in the tested reconstruction.
supporting_detail_raw: Four-gene construct lacking iliE still yields H/J.
caveat_raw: Possible roles in other native products remain unresolved.

claim_text: The ane locus causally produces aculenes A–D in A. aculeatus.
supporting_detail_raw: Multiple individual gene inactivations alter or abolish pathway products.
caveat_raw: MIBiG retired/SQ_A status does not negate the direct experimental evidence.

claim_text: AneC forms dauca-4,7-diene as the terpene entry scaffold.
supporting_detail_raw: AneC expression yields the terpene product and native deletion abolishes aculenes.

claim_text: AneF, AneD and AneG execute ordered C-12, C-10 and C-2 oxidations that drive demethylation to the nordaucane skeleton.
supporting_detail_raw: AneG C-2 carbonyl installation triggers C-12 decarboxylation.

claim_text: AneA, AneB and AneE complete alkene and L-proline tailoring that separates aculenes A/B from C/D.
supporting_detail_raw: AneB activates L-proline and AneE mediates transfer; AneA installs the 5,6-unsaturation.

claim_text: The N. crassa srd/pks-6 cluster is sufficient to produce sordarial when heterologously expressed.
supporting_detail_raw: Sordarial purified and NMR-confirmed from engineered A. nidulans.
caveat_raw: This is not direct native N. crassa production evidence.

claim_text: SrdA+C+D+E form the minimal tested combination yielding salicylic alcohol intermediate 2.
SrdI counteracts host reduction by oxidizing alcohol 2 back to aldehyde 3.
supporting_detail_raw: Adding srdI produces 3 with 2; chemistry matches homologous pyriculol oxidase.

claim_text: Native activation and ecological function of sordarial in N. crassa remain unresolved.
HBU-136 directly produces the isolated indole-diketopiperazine set under rice/1% MgCl2 culture.
supporting_detail_raw: Eight IDKPs isolated, including three new compounds.
caveat_raw: Direct production does not itself establish the proposed ctp locus.

claim_text: The ctp BGC and detailed pathway are candidate assignments based on homology to known indole-DKP clusters.
supporting_detail_raw: No HBU-136 pathway-specific knockout/reconstruction reported.

claim_text: Several isolated IDKPs show selective micromolar cytotoxicity against HL-60 or MCF-7 cells.
1.0% MgCl2 rice culture is a productive experimental context but not evidence of a specific molecular activation mechanism.
A. nanangensis MST-FP2251 directly produces a diverse nanangenine drimane-sesquiterpenoid chemotype.
The nanangenine BGC and detailed route are putative assignments from comparative bioinformatics.
supporting_detail_raw: No causal genetics/reconstruction in defining study.

claim_text: FE257_006542 is a candidate bifunctional terpene synthase/phosphatase, not a directly validated strain-specific enzyme assignment.
ATEG_03629 directly forms 5-methylorsellinic acid in heterologous expression.
ATEG_03630 activates and reduces the PKS-derived aryl acid to the corresponding aryl aldehyde.
The two-gene module demonstrates an aryl-aldehyde mechanism distinct from direct NR-PKS reductive release.
AtAS directly synthesizes preaspterpenacid I.
AtP450 directly performs C22 oxidative modification of preaspterpenacid I.
The defining study does not establish the complete downstream route to mature aspterpenacid metabolites or native A. terreus regulation.
verA is causally required for native verrucosidin production in P. polonicum X6.
supporting_detail_raw: Loss of verrucosidin across MEB, CYB and apple contexts with comparable morphology.

claim_text: verA transcription tracks verrucosidin-producing strains/conditions.
Neighboring X6 tailoring-gene functions are plausible but were not individually validated in the 2021 study.
A 2025 homologous NRRL995 cluster study resolves downstream deoxyverrucosidin tailoring chemistry but is not X6 strain-specific proof.
Deletion of an unrelated α-pyrone PKS cl3A does not remove verrucosidin, providing negative specificity evidence.
D. bispora CBS 962.96 naturally produces dendrothelin A-related backbone-N-methylated macrocycles.
DbiMA1 is a functional borosin precursor methyltransferase with an omphalotin-like methylation pattern.
The defining Pichia production of dendrothelin A used OphMA_DbiCORE + OphP, not intact DbiMA1 + DbiP.
supporting_detail_raw: Do not mislabel hybrid production as full native-cluster reconstruction.

claim_text: Recombinant dendrothelin A is nematotoxic to M. incognita with delayed time-dependent potency.
Native DbiP processing remains less directly established because the predicted DbiP model was N-terminally incomplete and not tested in the main Pichia cross-reactivity experiments.
L. edodes naturally produces lentinulin A-related backbone-N-methylated macrocycles in vegetative mycelium.
LedMA is a functional borosin precursor methyltransferase and is expressed in vegetative mycelium in prior work.
LedP directly processes OphMA and Led/Dbi core-hybrid precursor proteins to macrocycles in Pichia.
The principal recombinant lentinulin A production used an OphMA_LedCORE hybrid, not intact LedMA.
Recombinant lentinulin A is strongly nematotoxic to M. incognita.
AcdB directly constructs the aspcandine scaffold from 3-hydroxy-L-kynurenine plus one malonyl-CoA extension.
AcdB chain release furnishes the tricyclic pyrrolobenzazepine system rather than a conventional linear NRPS–PKS product.
AcdD is the canonical-locus kynurenine 3-monooxygenase supplying 3-hydroxy-L-kynurenine upstream of AcdB.
The MFS transporter is cluster-linked but its strain-specific export/protection role is not mechanistically established.
The canonical MIBiG locus and broader generated antiSMASH region must be kept distinct.
DbaI is the pathway-entry non-reducing PKS that supplies DHMBA.
supporting_detail_raw: ΔdbaI removes DHMBA and all five named downstream products.
caveat_raw: MIBiG boundary/coordinate annotation is less complete than the functional attribution.

claim_text: DbaA is the specific positive transcriptional regulator required for chemically induced activation of the dba/troA programme.
supporting_detail_raw: ΔdbaA blocks induction across the adjacent troA module and dba genes; overexpression activates cluster chemistry.
caveat_raw: The upstream sensing mechanism for the bacterial glycopeptide signal remains unresolved.

claim_text: TroA is required for the tropolone branch but not for azanidulone or tripyrnidone formation.
supporting_detail_raw: ΔtroA abolishes anhydrosepedonin and antibiotic C while non-tropolone products remain.
caveat_raw: Detailed oxidative ring-expansion mechanism is pathway-supported rather than isolated-enzyme proof in this strain.

claim_text: DbaB acts downstream of anhydrosepedonin in antibiotic-C formation.
supporting_detail_raw: ΔdbaB accumulates anhydrosepedonin and loses antibiotic C; DbaB is also required for tripyrnidone.
caveat_raw: The native genetics establish pathway position more directly than isolated catalytic chemistry.

claim_text: The dba/troA programme can be activated by a bacterial competitor through a defined glycopeptide-antibiotic signal.
supporting_detail_raw: S. mobaraensis confrontation and the corresponding purified chemical class induce the fungal programme; comparator Streptomyces do not show the same effect.
caveat_raw: This demonstrates signal sufficiency, not the identity of the fungal receptor/sensor.

claim_text: Iron-chelation and antibacterial phenotypes support a microbial-competition role for induced dba products.
supporting_detail_raw: Reference versus ΔdbaI extracts diverge strongly in iron-limited indicator assays, and purified tropolone products show antibacterial activity.
caveat_raw: Extract-level ecological evidence does not uniquely assign every phenotype to one individual congener.

claim_text: The brv locus is sufficient for heterologous reconstruction of brevione E biosynthesis.
supporting_detail_raw: Sequential gene combinations generated pathway intermediates and final product.
caveat_raw: Native regulation/ecology is not established by the heterologous system.

claim_text: BrvJ catalyzes the skeletal rearrangement responsible for the cycloheptenone-containing brevione branch.
supporting_detail_raw: Purified-enzyme reactions directly resolve the key branch-point chemistry.
caveat_raw: Other late tailoring enzymes have less isolated biochemical support.

claim_text: The accepted brevione E structure contains a substituted tetrahydrofuran rather than the historically proposed oxepane.
supporting_detail_raw: NMR-based reexamination during pathway work revised the ring assignment.
caveat_raw: Historical oxepane model retained only as provenance.

claim_text: Closely related Fe/2OG dioxygenases can have different outcomes on the same pathway substrate.
supporting_detail_raw: BrvJ rearranges while SetK preferentially hydroxylates; selectivity residues were interrogated.
caveat_raw: Do not transfer BrvJ function to homologs without direct evidence.

claim_text: MIBiG's source-category SQ_A label should not be interpreted as weak pathway causality.
supporting_detail_raw: Primary heterologous and biochemical evidence is strong despite database quality flag.
caveat_raw: Quality flag remains preserved as database provenance.

claim_text: ctc1-ctc4 are sufficient to generate the principal colletochlorin/colletorin pathway family in S. cerevisiae.
supporting_detail_raw: Restored CTC4 expression yields OA plus chlorinated and nonchlorinated prenylated products.
caveat_raw: Not every MIBiG-listed native congener was necessarily an endpoint of the reconstruction.

claim_text: CTC1 directly produces orsellinic acid as the first pathway intermediate.
supporting_detail_raw: OA appears in the initial construct even when CTC4 protein is undetectable.
caveat_raw: Collective construct still contains other ctc genes.

claim_text: CTC4 protein abundance is a limiting execution gate for downstream pathway production in the yeast system.
supporting_detail_raw: Initial polycistron lacks detectable CTC4 and stops at OA; extra CTC4 restores downstream metabolites.
caveat_raw: This is a heterologous-host execution bottleneck, not necessarily native regulation.

claim_text: Native ΔcclA activation reveals the product family but does not by itself identify the ctc locus.
supporting_detail_raw: ΔcclA increases metabolite diversity and exposes colletorin/colletochlorin derivatives.
caveat_raw: Gene-to-product causality comes from 2023 yeast reconstruction.

claim_text: MIBiG's broad 50.9-kb display and narrower 15.7-kb locus represent different boundary provenances.
supporting_detail_raw: Locus field 389265-404974 corresponds to the four ctc genes; visual region is broader.
caveat_raw: Use the narrower experimental locus for functional programme.

claim_text: The A. fumigatus Af293 spy BGC is causally linked to sartorypyrone-family biosynthesis by heterologous reconstruction and targeted-gene deletions.
supporting_detail_raw: Compounds 1–4 appear specifically in refactored strains and gene deletions localize pathway steps.
caveat_raw: Native Af293 activation is not demonstrated.

claim_text: SpyA is the initiating NR-PKS and produces triacetic acid lactone.
supporting_detail_raw: SpyA expression yields TAL; spyA deletion causes >100-fold loss of products 3/4.
caveat_raw: Small residual 3/4 formation in A. nidulans remains unexplained.

claim_text: SpyB performs the terminal acetylation converting sartorypyrones D/F to A/G.
supporting_detail_raw: spyB deletion abolishes acetylated endpoints and increases unacetylated precursors >100-fold.
caveat_raw: Function depends on the experimentally corrected downstream translation start site.

claim_text: SpyC, SpyD and SpyE resolve epoxidation, terpene cyclization and GGPP-supply steps, respectively.
supporting_detail_raw: Distinct stable intermediates/shunts accumulate in each deletant; reviewed SpyD annotation is concordant.
caveat_raw: Some mechanistic details remain inferred from metabolite relationships rather than purified enzymes.

claim_text: The spy pathway was cryptic in native A. fumigatus context and required heterologous access in the defining study.
supporting_detail_raw: Study describes a previously unknown A. fumigatus BGC and reveals products through A. nidulans expression.
caveat_raw: This does not prove the cluster is never expressed in native environments.

claim_text: The retired MIBiG interval/gene-count representation should be preserved as provenance, while the six-gene spyA-spyF set is the experimentally resolved functional programme.
supporting_detail_raw: Canonical source: 45.6-kb interval, gene_count 3; primary study: six-gene functional pathway with additional neighboring genes experimentally excluded.
caveat_raw: Do not rewrite canonical MIBiG provenance to mimic the functional core.

The broad six-gene MIBiG interval should not be treated as experimentally required in full because the defining biosynthetic platform is the three-enzyme Ova module.
The organism-name difference Metarhizium anisopliae ARSEF23 versus M. robertsii ARSEF23 is a taxonomic nomenclature update, not evidence for different experimental strains.
DrcA synthesizes CJ-20,557, a heterodimeric depside.

DrcB converts CJ-20,557 to duricamidepside.
The ltb cluster is causally responsible for luteodienoside A biosynthesis.
LtbA alone forms luteodiene A; LtbA and LtbB are minimally sufficient for luteodienoside A production in A. nidulans.
The C-terminal cAT domain of LtbA is required for glucinol-dependent offloading of luteodienoside A in vivo.
LtbC and LtbD are not essential for luteodienoside A production under the tested heterologous conditions.
The exact enzymatic conversion catalyzed by LtbB remains incompletely demonstrated because the direct cell-free glycosylation assay was negative.
Heterologous expression of PbpsA in A. oryzae produces a new 3,6-dialkyl-α-pyrone.
The authors propose that the PKS portion of PbpsA may be sufficient for pyrone formation; the NRPS contribution is unresolved.
The 3-ethyl substitution may be introduced by an endogenous A. oryzae enzyme rather than by PbpsA.
The broad four-gene MIBiG locus is not fully reconstructed in the defining study.
The EST1 indole-diterpene core is causally linked to emindole SA biosynthesis.
EstB1 is the pathway cyclase that generates the emindole SA architecture.
Historical emindole SA isolation is chemistry provenance and does not replace the 2023 pathway-causality evidence.
The MollA-MollF cluster is sufficient for mollicellin Z/Z1 biosynthesis in A. nidulans.
MollD is a bifunctional P450 involved in depsidone ether formation and C-3 methyl hydroxylation.
MollC performs decarboxylation and MollF performs aromatic dimethylallyl prenylation.
MollE's exact pathway role remains unresolved and is not assigned.
Deletion of sclA abolishes orange pigmentation and the seven sclerotiorin-like metabolites.
Deletion of sclI likewise abolishes the sclerotiorin-like metabolite family, establishing dual-PKS pathway dependence.
Detailed downstream tailoring assignments in the scl cluster are largely proposed from homology to characterized azaphilone pathways.
Clz14, Clz17 and Clz11 form a minimal heterologous module capable of producing L-731.120 from host benzoyl-CoA.
Clz14 and Clz17 are required for the reconstructed tricarboxylic core pathway.
Zaragozic acid A and L-731.120 occur in the native C. lunata strain, linking the reconstructed early module to the native pathway.
Late oxidative conversion from reconstructed intermediates to zaragozic acid A was not fully reconstituted in the defining study.
Cristazarin production is strongly carbon-source dependent, with fructose/glucose supporting the productive programme.
crz1-crz9, centered on the NR-PKS crz7/PKS22, are coexpressed under cristazarin-producing conditions and form the leading candidate BGC.
The proposed crz biosynthetic route is not causally validated by pathway-specific knockout or heterologous reconstruction.
DesB with the indole-diterpene core generates emindole DA and DB in a PAX-null heterologous system.
DesB is a stereodivergent Markovnikov-like cyclase whose control differs from EstB1.
DesM functionally complements the corresponding paxilline-pathway methyltransferase function.
The fifth ORF in the canonical DES locus is not functionally assigned.
Heterologous expression of the cryptic C. militaris HR-PKS/trans-ER/P450 module in A. nidulans produces cordypyrone A and B.
Cordypyrone A and B were structurally assigned by 1D and 2D NMR.
The products showed only modest antibacterial activity in the organisms tested in the defining study.
The broad current MIBiG display should not be interpreted as evidence that every neighboring ORF is required for cordypyrone biosynthesis.
PKS21 is strongly upregulated in the biruloquinone-producing LFF variant.
Six neighboring genes including PKS21 are coexpressed and delimit the proposed biruloquinone cluster.
No pathway-specific knockout or heterologous reconstruction establishes causal PKS21-to-biruloquinone attribution.
sidC with sidA/sidL is sufficient to produce ferricrocin in heterologous yeast.
